name: Glass AI
description: Glass Health is a comprehensive clinical AI platform combining AI scribe, differential diagnosis generator, clinical plan creator, and billing/coding suggestions in one workflow. Pricing: Free Lite tier (limited usage), Starter $20/month, Pro $90/month, Max $200/month (adds EHR integration with Epic, eClinicalWorks, athenahealth, Elation). Key differentiator: the only platform combining clinical decision support with ambient documentation—useful for complex cases where diagnosis support matters alongside scribing. Not optimized for mental health-specific documentation; therapists should use purpose-built tools. Best for generalists and hospitalists wanting clinical AI beyond just note generation.
short_description: Clinical AI platform: scribe + differential diagnosis + treatment planning. Free Lite, $20-90-200/mo. EHR integration on Max tier.
one_liner: AI scribe + clinical decision support. Free to $200/mo. Diagnosis + treatment + notes.

pricing.free_tier_notes: Lite tier is a genuine free option (not time-limited trial) with capped scribing and diagnosis features.

tiers.name: Lite (Free)
tiers.description: Limited scribing and differential diagnosis. Good for testing the platform. Not time-limited.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.description: Extended scribing or diagnosis features. For clinicians wanting more than Lite limits.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.description: Unrestricted scribe and differential diagnosis engine. Full clinical Q&A, treatment planning, documentation.

tiers.name: Max
tiers.description: All Pro features + EHR integration with Epic, eClinicalWorks, athenahealth, Elation. Billing/coding suggestions.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.description: Dedicated support, custom integrations, enhanced security, volume discounts.

pricing.notes: EHR integration specifically requires $200/mo Max tier—higher than pure ambient scribes. Glass Health best when clinician wants clinical Q&A, diagnosis support, treatment planning, documentation, and billing in one workflow.

compliance.security_note: HIPAA compliant with BAA available. Enterprise tier includes enhanced security features.

ambient_ai.description: Ambient clinical documentation captures patient conversations and generates structured notes.

differential_diagnosis.description: AI-powered differential diagnosis generator based on patient presentation and clinical data.

clinical_plan.description: Clinical plan creator for treatment planning and evidence-based recommendations.

billing_coding.description: Billing and coding suggestions to support revenue capture.

clinical_qa.description: Clinical Q&A for real-time medical information and decision support.

best_for: Hospitalists and generalists wanting clinical decision support alongside scribing
Clinicians handling complex diagnostic cases needing AI differential diagnosis
Practices wanting one platform for documentation + diagnosis + treatment planning

not_for: Mental health therapists—Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo) purpose-built for therapy
Psychiatrists needing medication management—Freed ($39-119/mo) or mdhub better

faqs.q: How much does Glass AI cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Glass AI offers Free Lite tier (limited but genuine free option), Starter $20/month, Pro $90/month, and Max $200/month with EHR integration. Enterprise custom pricing available for larger organizations.

faqs.q: What makes Glass AI different from other AI scribes?
faqs.a: Glass AI combines AI scribe with clinical decision support—differential diagnosis generator, clinical plan creator, and treatment recommendations. Most AI scribes only do documentation. Glass Health is for clinicians who want clinical Q&A and diagnosis support alongside note generation.

faqs.q: Does Glass AI integrate with EHRs?
faqs.a: Yes, but only on the Max tier ($200/mo). Epic, eClinicalWorks, athenahealth, and Elation integrations are included. Lower tiers require copy-paste workflow.

faqs.q: Is Glass AI good for mental health practices?
faqs.a: No. Glass AI is designed for primary care and general medical specialties with its diagnostic features. Mental health therapists should use Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo). Psychiatrists should consider Freed ($39-119/mo) or mdhub.

faqs.q: Glass AI vs Freed: which is better?
faqs.a: Freed ($39-119/mo) is cheaper and better for pure scribing. Glass AI ($20-200/mo) adds clinical decision support—differential diagnosis, treatment planning, clinical Q&A. If you want comprehensive clinical AI beyond documentation, Glass AI. For pure ambient scribing at lower cost, Freed.
